text: and i know if you go into one of the workspace routes, one of them that has shaders, lets you toggle variation / quality levels, can we just bake them all in to the set, rather than needing to go sift through the trenches
resolution: Baked shader variations into the assignable material set instead of leaving them hidden behind ShaderLab controls. The shader catalog now generates stable preset texture ids for every fill-board authored take across all five quality grades, plus road overlay presets; the texture registry and assignable material catalog expose those presets with semantic shelves, while the no-JS compile resolver maps preset ids to their frozen WGSL data so painted faces ship correctly. Tests now cover preset id uniqueness, data packing, material catalog exposure, and compile resolution.
